γάζα.definition: treasure, Thphr.HP8.11.5, OGI54.22 (iii; large sum of money, Plb.11.34.12

γαῖα.definition: gen. Hom. , Trag; earth, earth thrown up to form a cairn, Il.23.256; of potters' earth, Eub.43, cf. Sannyr.4; Antiph.52.3; the forms in codd. of LXX are written for etc

γαιών.definition: heap of earth, boundary-heap, Tab.Heracl.1.136: IG14.352ii 83

γάλα.definition: [⏑⏑], gen. (also dat; prov. of rare and dainty things, Ar.V.508, Av.734, Men.936; Mnesim.9, cf. Ach. Tat.Intr.Arat.4

γάλαξ.definition: a kind of shell-fish, prob. Mactra lactea, Arist.HA528a23

γαλέη.definition: contr. a name given to various; wild ferret , Arist.HA580b26, Ruf.Fr.79, Str.3.2.6; Hdt. l.c., Diogenian.3.71

γέεννα.definition: Hebr. gé-hinnóm, the valley of Hinnom, which represented the place of future punishment, Ev.Matt.5.22, al

γέη.definition: = Orac. ap. Eus.PE4.9: from the earth, Orac.ib.5.9

γεισήπους.definition: projecting end of rafter, IG22.463.51:—hence ib.114: the spellings , and are less correct

γέλως.definition: Aeol. gen. Att. dat; metaph. of waves, = Opp.H.4.334

γένος.definition: or race, stock, kin; direct descent, opp. collateral relationship, Is.8.33; hereditary monarchies, Arist.Pol.1285a16, 1313a10

γέρων.definition: old man, Il.1.33, etc.: pleon; Elders, Chiefs, Il.2.404 sq., cf. 9.574, Od.2.14; later, Senators, esp. at Sparta, Hdt.1.65, 6.57, Pl.Lg.692a, IG22.687, Arist.Pol.1265b38 .1346, but usu. q. v.); in other states, as at …

γεῦμα.definition: taste, smack of a thing; food, Hp.Acut.10: metaph., Ph.1.544

γεώπεδον.definition: portion or plot of ground, garden, esp. within a town, Hdt.7.28 ; cf

γεωχαρής.definition: fond of the earth, of creeping plants, Jul.Or.5.175d

γῆ.definition: occasionally in Hom., freq. in Hes., and the; earth, as an element, Xenoph.27, Anaxag.4, Pl.Prt.320d, Lg.889b, Arist.Metaph.989a5, Cael.306a18, etc

γῆρας.definition: gen. Il.22.60, al., Archil.116; cast skin, slough of a serpent, Arist.HA549b26, Nic.Th.31, Antig.Mir.20, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.35.4; of crabs, Arist.HA600b20, Thphr.Fr.177

γήχυτον.definition: the soft mould or soil on the earth's surface, Gal.19.91

γιγγίς.definition: kind of turnip, French carrot, Alex.Trall.1.15

γίγγλυμος.definition: metal pivot or gudgeon on which a door turns, = IG4.1484.74 , 11.165.15 :— written ib.142.49

γλαρίς.definition: chisel, whether for wood or stone

γλαῦκος.definition: an eatable fish of grey colour; as pr. n. esp. of a Chian inventor: hence prov., c. inf., 'it does not need a genius to . . ', Pl.Phd.108d, etc

γλαύξ.definition: Att. Euphronius ap; an unknown bird, Thphr.Sign.52

γλήνη.definition: Il.8.164, perh. doll, plaything; socket of a joint, distd. from as being not so deep, Gal.2.736

γληνίς.definition: perh. a measure of capacity, IG5.1447

γλῖνος.definition: or Cretan maple, Acer creticum, Thphr.HP3.3.1, 3.11.2

γλοιός.definition: any glutinous substance, gum, Hdt.3.112; as Adj. slippery, knavish, Ar.Nu. l.c

γλύκων.definition: sweet one: you dear silly creature! Ar.Ec.985

γλώξ.definition: only pl. beard of corn, Hes.Sc.398

γνώμων.definition: one that knows or; expert witness or valuer, SIG169.52

γονιμότης.definition: vitality, of the embryo; generative power, Dam.Pr.108

γόνος.definition: and , E.IA793: late Ion; product, of plants, Anacreont.54.7; of the silver mines at Laureion, A.Eu.946 ; Ar.V.1116 codd

γόνυ.definition: gen. Ep. and Ion. (for; of a sitting posture, will be glad to bend the knee so as to sit down and rest, Il.7.118, cf. 19.72; but also, bow the knee in submission, LXXIs.45.23; ib.3 Ki.19.18, v. sub on one's knees, Il.…

γράμμα.definition: Dor. prob. in IG4.506; written character, letter, Hdt.1.139, 148, etc.: in pl., letters, characters, A.Pr.460; Ep.Gal.6.11; the letters, the alphabet, Hdt.5.58; Pl.Cra.390e; S.Fr.514; Hdt.4.87; Pl.Lg.689d; to have lea…

γραφίσκος.definition: surgical instrument for extracting arrows, etc., Cels.7.5.3

γρύψ.definition: gen. griffin, Aristeas ap. Hdt.3.116; a bird, prob. the Lämmergeier, LXXLe.11.13, De.14.13

γυάλας.definition: a Megarian cup, Philet. ap. Ath.11.467c, Parth.ibid

γύαλον.definition: hollow, in Il. always of the breast-; hollow of a vessel, E.IA1052 ; hollow vessel, Id.Andr.1093

γύαλος.definition: cubical stone, EM243.12; also oxyt. as Adj., Call.Fr.anon.331

γυιοτακής.definition: melting or wasting the limbs; Pass., with pining limbs, ib.71

γυνή.definition: Dor. Boeot. , gen; mortal woman, opp.goddess, 14.315, Od.10.228, etc

γυργαθίον.definition: Dim. of sq., in Alchemy, net for suspending substances in fluids, PHolm.18.17

γωνία.definition: corner, angle, Hdt.1.51, Pl.Men.84d, etc; metaph., corner, secluded spot, Pl.Grg.485d; Act.Ap.26.26

γωνοειδής.definition: = Democr. ap. Thphr.Sens.65, freq. written in codd. of Thphr

γαιόω.definition: make land, make solid, Tz.H.1.907, al

γαίω.definition: impf. Hsch.:—rejoice, exult, Hom. only in Il., in phrase, Il.1.405, 5.906, 8.51; Emp.27.4

γαλήνη.definition: stillness of the sea, calm; lead sulphide, galena, Plin.HN33.95, 34.159

γαμέω.definition: of mere sexual intercourse, take for a paramour, Od.1.36, Luc.Asin.32; E.Tr.44

γαμήλιος.definition: of or for a wedding, bridal, nuptial; as Subst., , bride cake, Philetaer.13.5

γαμψόω.definition: make curved: only used in Pass., to be or become so, ib.619a17

γανάω.definition: glitter, gleam, of metals; Hom. always; exult, rejoice, Opp.H.1.659

γανόω.definition: make bright, polish, Plu.2.74e: metaph; tin, lacker, Crito ap.Gal.12.490; Aët.12.55, cf. Eust.1188.61

γάνυμαι.definition: mostly pres.; impf. Q.S.5.652; Jul.Or.1.8c: Ep. fut. Il.14.504: pf. part. Anacreont.35.3, Them.Or.13.177a: plpf. ib.20.240d, al.:—brighten up, be glad or happy, he is glad at heart, Il.13.493: c. dat., 14.504, cf. 20.…

γάνωμα.definition: = brightness, brilliance; joy, gladness, Ph.1.335, al

γάνωσις.definition: metaph., making glad, brightening, Phld.Mus.p.30 K

γείνομαι.definition: as Pass., only pres. and impf., to be born, cf. , at one's birth, Il.20.128, 24.210, Od.4.208, cf. Hes.Th.82, Alc.Supp.14: impf. Il.22.477, Hes.Sc.88

γελάω.definition: Ep. Od.21.105, Aeol. Hdn.Gr.2.463; abs., laugh, Od.14.465; 18.163; 20.347; Il.6.484; S.Aj.1011; of feigned laughter, Il.15.101; his heart laughed within him, 21.389; Hdt.4.36:—Pass., for the sake of a laugh being rais…

γεμίζω.definition: fill full of, load, freight or charge; later, c. acc. rei, to fill it full of water, Paus.3.13.3:—Pass., AP12.85

γεναρχέω.definition: to be the ancestor of the human race, Iamb.Myst.10.5

γενάρχης.definition: founder or first ancestor of a; ruler of created beings, Corp.Herm.13.21, cf. Orph.H.13.8

γενειάς.definition: bandage for the chin, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.20.9, Gal.18 .786

γενειάω.definition: = grow a beard, get a beard

γεννάω.definition: fut. Med. in pass. sense, D.S.19.2; produce, grow, get, S.Aj.1077

γέννημα.definition: that which is produced or born; breeding, . . S.Ant.471

γεραίρω.definition: Ep. impf. Il.7.321: fut; Hsch.:—Pass., prob. in Nic.Al.396

γεράνιον.definition: Geranium tuberosum, a plant; substance used in Alchemy, Pelag.Alch.p.256 B

γερανίς.definition: a kind of surgical bandage, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.47 tit., Gal.18.814

γερόντιον.definition: Dim. of little old man; the Carthaginian Senate, Plb.6.51.2

γερουσία.definition: Council of Elders, senate, E.Rh.401: esp; sacred college, IG3.702 , cf. 7.2808 , etc

γερουσίας.definition: member of the at Sparta, IG5.31, al.: pl., ib.62.19; also, official of a guild, ib.206, 209

γεύω.definition: fut. Anaxipp.1.27: aor. Hdt.7.46, E.Cyc.149: -Med., fut. Od.17.413, etc.: aor. 20.181, etc.; Ep. for Il.21.61, 20.258: 3pl. opt. E.IA423: pf. A. v. infr., etc. : plpf. Th.2.70:-give a taste of, Hdt.7.46; E.Cyc.149, Th…

γεφυρόω.definition: make into a causeway or embankment, Il.15.357

γεωμορέω.definition: till or farm the land, Alex. ap. Eus.PE9.22

γεωρυχέω.definition: dig in the earth, dig a mine, Hdt.4.200, Ael.NA16.15

γεωτομία.definition: turning up the earth, ploughing, Eleg.Alex.Adesp.1.1, Max.499

γηθέω.definition: 3 sg. Il.14.140, Dor. Theoc.1.54 in Id.Pr.157 ): impf. Il.7.127, 214: fut. 8.378, etc.: aor. Ep. Hes.Sc.116, Dor. Pi.P.4.122, cf. Limen.7: pf. , Dor. with 3 sg. Epich.109 , Il.8.559, etc.: plpf. restored by Elmsl. in …

γημόρος.definition: Dor. and Trag. Trag.Adesp.208; = Lat. tresviri agris dividundis, D.H.9.52

γήπεδον.definition: = plot of ground, Pl.Lg.741c; Trag. used Dor. form acc. to St. Byz.: hence for , A.Pr.829

γηράσκω.definition: fut. Critias1.5 (and in; causal in aor. 1 bring to old age, A.Supp.894; AP6.94

γηρύω.definition: Dor. and Aeol. Sapph.Supp.25.20, etc; trans., sing of, celebrate, Pi.N.7.83; Id.O.13.50, etc

γίγνομαι.definition: Ion. and after Arist. (Att; abs., come into being opp. Emp.17.11, Pl.Phd.102e, cf. Ti.29a; and so

γιγνώσκω.definition: Dor. , Aeol., Ion., and; folld. by relat. clauses, . . I perceive that . . , 21.209; Il.22.10; Ar.Nu.1095; . . Heraclit.108, A.Pr.104,379, etc.; . . D.21.143; . . Il.21.266; Pl.Phlb.60d: c. acc. and relat. clause, Il.…

γλαγοπήξ.definition: curdling milk, bowls for the purpose, AP6.35

γλαυκιάω.definition: Hom. only in Ep. part. glaring; have a glare blindly, . . Q.S.12.408

γλαύκιον.definition: juice of the horned poppy, Glaucium; kind of duck, perh. white-eyed duck, Anas leucophthalmus, Ath.9.395c

γλαφυρία.definition: elegance, Plu.Pyrrh.8 ; of mathematical demonstrations, neatness, Iamb.in Nic.p.38P., al.: metaph., smoothness of manner, Plu.2.1065d

γλάφω.definition: scrape up, dig up, hollow, of; engrave, CR12.282

γλεύκινος.definition: made with as a vehicle; partly fermented, Gal.UP4.3

γλοιάζω.definition: wink, twinkle with the eyes, Hp. ap. Gal.19.91, EM234.45

γλυκίζω.definition: treat with sweetmeats; intr., have a sweet flavour, Gp.6.15.1, cf. 5.26.10:—also in Pass., become sweet, form lead acetate, Zos.Alch.p.248B

γλυφίς.definition: in early writers always pl; pen-knife, AP6.62 , 64

γλύφω.definition: fut. LXXEx.28.9: aor; note down or write [on waxen tablets], AP11.289

γλωττίς.definition: glottis, mouth of the windpipe; mouthpiece of a pipe, in which the reed was inserted, Luc.Harm.1, Theo Sm.p.61 H.; of a trumpet, HeroSpir.1.16

γνώμη.definition: means of knowing: hence, mark, token; organ by which one perceives or knows, intelligence

γνώρισμα.definition: that by which a thing is made known; in criminal trials, corpus delicti, PMasp.143.16, al

γνωσιγραφία.definition: picturing of the effect of a verdict, as a Rhetorical device, Aps.p.304 H

γοάω.definition: Mosch.3.88, A.R.3.995, Q.S.2.648: Dor. 3pl. Mosch.3.24; opt. Il.24.664; Od.24 190; Ep. inf. Il.14.502; part. 6.373, etc.: Ep. impf. Od.10.567 , Ion. Od.8.92: Ep. fut. Il.21.124, later AP7.638 , Nonn.D.2.137: aor. 1 IG…

γοητεύω.definition: bewitch, beguile, Pl.Grg.483e, etc.:—Pass; abs., play the wizard, D.L.8.59

γομφιάζω.definition: have pain in the back teeth or gnash them; of the teeth, suffer pain, ib.Ez.18.2

γομφόω.definition: fasten with bolts or nails, esp. of ships; metaph., curdle, Emp.33

γομφωτήρ.definition: a ship-builder, AP9.31; surgical instrument for excising bone, Antyll. ap. Orib.44.23.15

γονατίζω.definition: thrust with the knee, Cratin.399; bend the knee, Aq.Ge.24.11,41.43

γουνάζομαι.definition: fut. aor. 1 Orph.A.618, subj. A.R.4.747, cf. Orph.A.943: :—Ep. Verb, clasp another's knees : hence, implore, entreat, abs., Il.11.130: c. inf., . . in whose name . . I implore you to stand your ground, 15.665; Od.13.3…

γουνόομαι.definition: contr. = only pres. and impf., Il.21.74, Od.6.149, Archil.75, Anacr.1.1, etc.; Od.11.29; 10.521; 4.433, etc

γράφω.definition: fut. Hdt.1.95, etc.: aor. Ep; Math., describe a figure, Euc.Post.3, al., Archim.Sph.Cyl.1.23, al., Gal.1.47

γρυπανίζω.definition: become wrinkled, of the earth in earthquake, Antipho Soph.31

γρύπωσις.definition: crooking, hooking, of the nails, Cael.Aur.CP2.32, Steph.in Hp.1.187 D

γυίζω.definition: take in the hand, coined by EM309.31, cf. Eust.250.36

γυιόδαμος.definition: taming limbs, conquering, . . Pi.I.5.59: unless from Subst. athlete

γυιόω.definition: lame, . . Il.8.402, cf. 416; wound, Nic.Th.731; lame, Hes.Th.858, cf. Hp.Art.52; weaken, reduce, Id.Acut.59; deprive of strength, Orph.Fr.135

γυμνασία.definition: Rhet., practice: hence, arrangement, disposition, TheoProg.4, cf. Aphth.Prog.6

γυμνάσιον.definition: metaph., write an exercise or essay, Gal.19.17; gymnastic school, E.Ph.368, Antipho3.2.3, Pl.Criti.117c ,etc.; from our school, Ar.V.526: pl., the hippodrome, E.Hipp.229

γύμνασμα.definition: physical exercises, Ruf. ap. Orib.inc.2.15, Luc.Anach.8,Ath.10.413c

γυμνόω.definition: strip naked, strip the; metaph., lay bare, Ph.1.118:—Pass., Dam.Pr.400

γυρεύω.definition: run round in a circle, Str.6.1.8: c. acc. cogn., Babr.29.4

γῦρος.definition: ring, circle, Plb.29.11.5; trench made round a tree, Thphr.CP3.4.1, Orph.Fr.280.4; Alciphr.3.13

γυψόω.definition: rub with chalk, chalk over, Hdt.3.24,8.27; plaster with gypsum, Gp.4.15.13

γῶ.definition: coined by Gramm., as etym. of etc., El.Gud. s.v. cf. EM244.6, Philox. ap. Orion39

γωνίωσις.definition: name for a pulse, coined by Archig. ap. Gal.9.324

γαίηθεν.definition: Adv. from the land, Opp.H.1.39; out of the earth, Orac. ap.Eus.PE6.2 ; from the earth, Orac. ib.5.9

γάρ.definition: causal Conj., used alone or with other Particles. I. introducing the reason or cause of what precedes, for, Il.1.56, etc.; but freq. in expl. of that wh. is implied in the preceding clause, . . 2.118, etc.: hence, b. …

γε.definition: Dor. and Boeot. enclitic Particle, giving; with single words, at least, at any rate, but often only to be rendered by italics in writing, or emphasis in pronunciation: . . such is the power of iron, Od.9.393; . . if t…

γνύξ.definition: Adv., with bent knee, Il., always in phrase falling on the knee, 5.309,357,al.; later Arat.921; A.R.3.1310; Orac. ap. Zos.2.6: in later Prose, Gal.UP3.15

γρῖπος.definition: = AP6.23, Artem.2.14; haul or take of fish, D.L.1.32

γαιηφάγος.definition: earth-eating, of worms, Numen. ap. Ath.7.305a; cf

γεφύρωσις.definition: furnishing with a causeway or bridge, Str.1.3.18 ; Arr.An.5.7.3; in concrete sense, Ctes.Fr.29.17

γουττᾶτον.definition: a kind of cake, Chrysipp. Tyan. ap. Ath.14.647c

γονόρροια.definition: spermatorrhoea, Antyll. ap; in women, blennorrhagia, Aret.SD2.11

γονή.definition: that which engenders, seed, Hes.Op.733, Hdt.3.101, 109, Hp.Genit.3, Arist.GA726a18, etc.: pl., Pi.N.7.84, S.Ant.950

γουνοπαχής.definition: thick-kneed, v.l. cramping the knees, Hes.Sc.266

γενείασις.definition: growth of the beard, in pl., Plot.4.3.13

γλυκυπράτιον.definition: shop where sweetmeats are sold, Gloss.:—also , dealer in sweetmeats, ib

γαργαρεών.definition: uvula, Hp.Prog.[23]; a morbid condition thereof, = Hp.Aff.4

γνάθος.definition: jaw, Prose form of also freq; cheek, in pl., Hp.VM19, Gal.2.424, etc.; D.19.314, cf. Ruf.Onom.47, Gal.18.423

γενετή.definition: = II.3, from the hour of birth, Il.24.535, Od.18.6; Arist.EN1144b6; opp. ib.1154a33; later Iamb.VP30.171

γεωγραφέω.definition: describe the earth's surface, Str.1.1.16, Arist.Mu.393b20:—Pass., geographic description, title of Strabo's work, Ath.14.657f

γλυκύδωρος.definition: with sweet gifts, B.3.3; sweet gift brought in thy honour, B.5.4

γόμφωμα.definition: that which is fastened by bolts; = Id.2.321d, Longus2.26

γυρόω.definition: make round, LXXSi.43.12; bend; plant in a Arat.9, Ph.2.294; make a round a tree, ib.402, Gp.4.3.1:—Med., dig, trench, Nic.Al.514

γένεσις.definition: manner of birth, Hdt.1.204, 6.69, etc.; race, descent, Id.2.146; S.Tr.380; opp. IG12.181

γονικόθεν.definition: Adv. by inheritance from parents, PMasp.151.182

γαληνισμός.definition: calming, Epicur.Ep.1p.32U.; calming of the conscience, Arist.Ep.5

γλαυκοχαίτης.definition: with greyish hair or mane, Choerob.in Cod. Barocc.50f.200

γηπετής.definition: falling or fallen to earth, E.Ph.668

γερόντειος.definition: belonging to an old man or old age, Ar.Fr.715

γαλάκτιον.definition: Dim. of M.Ant.5.4: in pl., fancy bread made with milk, Alciphr.Fr.6.10

γομφοπαγής.definition: fastened with bolts: metaph., creaky, of the long compound words of Aeschylus, Ar.Ra.824

γέλγις.definition: gen. also and : pl. Thphr.HP7.4.11, CP1.4.5:—head of garlic, and in pl., the cloves which compose it, Id.HP7.4.12, cf. Hp.Nat.Mul.77; AP6.232

γαρότας.definition: Sicilian for a bullock, Athanis1, = Dionys.Trag.12

γραοτρεφής.definition: reared by an old woman, coddled, Eust.971.41

γραμματίζω.definition: teach the spelling of a word; to be a secretary, IG5.1432.19 ; Boeot. IG7.1739 , al

γλαύκινος.definition: bluish-grey, Plu.2.821e; oil flavoured with Edict.Diocl.32.67

γονυπετής.definition: falling on the knee, Tim.Pers.189; a kneeling posture, E.Ph.293

γόγγρος.definition: conger-eel, Antiph.26.12, Alex.15.15; tubercular disease in olive-trees, Thphr.HP1.8.6

γνωριστής.definition: one that takes cognizance of; diviner, LXX4 Ki.23.24

γαυρίαμα.definition: arrogance, exultation, LXXJu.10.8, Phld.Mort.18, Plu.Aem.27, etc

γεώργημα.definition: in pl., operations of husbandry, Pl.Lg.674c

γάϊοςα.definition: Dor.for onland, A.Supp.826; = prob. in A.Supp.156

γαλεοειδής.definition: of the shark kind, Arist.HA565a20:—more usu. ib.505a5, al

γνωρίζω.definition: pf. Pl.Phdr.262b:—make; c. acc. pers., make known, Plu.Fab.21; commend, App.Mac.9.6

γέγειος.definition: earth-born, Call.Fr.252b: hence, ancient, Hecat.362 J.; Call.Fr.252: Comp. ib.103

γελγιδόομαι.definition: Pass., form a compound bulb, of garlic, Thphr.HP7.4.11

γαστρίον.definition: Dim. of paunch, SIG1002.9; cake, made with , EM221.45

γαγγλίον.definition: encysted tumour on a tendon or aponeurosis, Philagr. ap.Aët.15.9 , Heras ap.Gal.13.815, etc.; also on the head, Paul.Aeg.6.39; the nerve-knots now called ganglia are compared to such a tumour, Gal.UP16.5

γραιόομαι.definition: Pass., become aged, withered, of a vine, AP9.261

γλύφανος.definition: tool for carving, knife, chisel, h.Merc.41, Theoc.1.28; pen-knife, AP6.63

γωνιόομαι.definition: Pass., become angular, Dsc.3.7; Procl.in Euc.p.163F

γονατόομαι.definition: Pass., become or be jointed, of grasses, reeds, etc., Thphr.HP8.2.4, Dsc.3.51

γυμνητεία.definition: light-armed troops; nakedness, Corn.ND15; going unclothed, as a symptom of insanity, Ptol.Tetr.170

γένειον.definition: part covered by the beard, chin; beard, Hdt.6.117: pl., Theoc.6.36, J.AJ11.5.3, Paus.2.10.3, Theo Sm.p.104H

γρυπόομαι.definition: Pass., to become hooked, of the nails, Hp.Prog.17, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.18, Gal.8.47

γαιονόμος.definition: dwelling in the land: inhabitant, A.Supp.54

γεγωνοκώμη.definition: filling the village with clamour, Com.Adesp.1354

γενεῆθεν.definition: Adv. from birth, by descent, Arat.260; AP7.415

γονεύω.definition: produce, Thphr.CP1.14.1; Id.HP8.10.5; of animals, Plu.2.980d:—Pass., ib.981d

γερροχελώνη.definition: penthouse, mantlet, used in siege- works, Ph.Bel.98.19

γυροδρόμος.definition: running round in a circle, a millstone, AP9.20

γραφοειδής.definition: of the styloid process of the ulna, Gal.2.252,271

γρυμέα.definition: = I , trash, trumpery, Sotad.Com.1.3; of persons, riff-raff, Phld.Ir.p.65 W., cf. Them.Or.21.257a; Dam.Isid.293:—hence Luc.Lex.3

γαλακτίζω.definition: to be milky in appearance, Dsc.2.144, 175; form a milky way, Phlp.in Mete.117.20

γηρυγόνος.definition: born of sound, i. e. echoes, Theoc.Syrinx6

γαιοφανής.definition: earth-coloured, in Comp., Archig. ap. Orib.8.2.4 ; the earthy appearance of the moon, Placit.2.30.1 codd

γλώσσασπις.definition: one who uses his tongue as his shield and defence, EM235.39

γνωμονεύω.definition: measure as on a sun-dial, test, v.l. in Pl.R.516e

γενέτης.definition: begetter, ancestor, E.Or.1011; produced, Olymp.in Mete.94.9

γραμμίζω.definition: prob. f.l. for of a game , Eust.633.63

γαλεός.definition: dog-fish or small shark, Pl.Com.137; = I.3, Aret.CD1.4

γεωτραγία.definition: an eating of earthy substances, Hp.Morb.4.55

γιζί.definition: a kind of cassia, Gal.14.67; Dsc.1.13; Peripl.M.Rubr.12; Orib.Syn.2.56.17

γογγυλάτης.definition: of Zeus, hurling balls of fire, Lyc.435

γωνιοβόμβυξ.definition: one that buzzes in a corner, nickname of Grammarians, Herodic. ap. Ath.5.222a

γαρέλαιον.definition: paste made of and oil, Gal.6.716

γεγωνίσκω.definition: lengthd. pres. for cry aloud; c. acc. rei, tell out, proclaim, A.Pr.627, E.El.809

γλαυκίσκος.definition: a fish so called from its colour; a plant, Hegesand.35

γνωτοφόνος.definition: murderer of another's brother, Nonn.D.26.82:— fem. murderess of a brother, Lyc.1318

γυπάριον.definition: Dim. of sq., nest, cranny, Ar.Eq.793

γεῦσις.definition: sense of taste, Democr.11; a tasting, LXXDa.5.2

γελοιάω.definition: Ep. for in aor. part. h.Ven.49

γυιοβόρος.definition: gnawing the limbs, eating, Hes.Op.66; AP9.443

γλαυκίζω.definition: to be bluish-grey, of marble, Str.5.2.5

γύνανδρος.definition: of doubtful sex, womanish; of a woman, virago, Ph.1.183,2.379

γρυπάετος.definition: a kind of griffin or wyvern, Ar.Ra.929

γλυκυφαγία.definition: the use of sweet food, Alex.Trall.1.15

γωνιαῖος.definition: on or at the angle, LXXJb.38.6; angular, i. e. hard to pronounce, Pl.Com.67

γελασείω.definition: Desiderat. of to be ready to laugh, Pl.Phd.64b

γραφίς.definition: = I, AP6.63 , 65; embroidery, AP5.275 : but in pl., = paintings, Nonn.D.25.433

γωνιάζω.definition: place at an angle, Porph.in Cat.132.31

γάποτος.definition: to be drunk up by Earth, of libations, A.Ch.97,164, Pers.621

γλωσσίδος.definition: inflammation of the tongue, in horses, Hippiatr.130

γραολογία.definition: old wife's talk, gossip, S.E.M.1.141: pl., Porph.Chr.34

γαλιάγκων.definition: weasel-armed, i.e. short-armed, Hp.Art.12, al.:—more correctly written in Arist.Phgn.808a31, 813a12, Plu.2.520c

γεισόλογχος.definition: with a cornice of spear-heads, metaph. of thole-pins, prob. in Tim.Pers.4

γαμίζω.definition: give a daughter in marriage, A.D.Synt.280.11, 1 Ep.Cor.7.38

γηπάτταλος.definition: oblong radish, com. word in Luc.Lex.2

γραφιοειδής.definition: like a stylus, styloid process of the temporal bone, Gal.UP7.19, 11.4

γήρυμα.definition: sound, of a trumpet, A.Eu.569 : pl., Plu.2.973a

γλαυκότης.definition: greyness, of the eyes, Arist.GA778a18; Plu.Sull.2; also Corn.ND35

γραμματεύς.definition: secretary, registrar, title of; metaph., recorder, of memory, Pl.Phlb.39a

γλύκιος.definition: sugary, sickly, Arist.EE1238a28; v.l. for in S.Ph.1461

γραμμοτόκος.definition: mother of lines, of the leaden plummet, AP6.63

γλάγος.definition: poet. for , milk, Il.2.471, Pi.Fr.106, Nic.Al.385

γρύζω.definition: fut. Ar.Eq.294 codd., LXXEx.11.7; fut. = will liquefy, Arist.Pr.876b18

γαμησείω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to marry, Alciphr.1.13, 3.37

γλαυκώλενος.definition: of Tethys, with sea-grey arms, Hymn.Is.148

γυαλοθώραξ.definition: cuirass composed of front- and back-piece, Paus.10.26.2

γομφίασις.definition: toothache or gnashing of teeth, Dsc.2.59

γυροειδής.definition: like a circle, round. Adv. Dsc.2.173

γύμνωσις.definition: stripping, Plu.Lyc.14, cf; exposure, LXXGe.9.22; his defenceless side , Th.5.71

γεωδαισία.definition: land-dividing: mensuration, opp. the science of geometry, Arist.Metaph.997b26, Jul.Gal.178b, Procl.in Euc.p.25 F

γεῖσος.definition: - foreg., LXXEz.43.17: pl., BCH35.76 ; dat. pl. OGI483.127 :—also Gloss

γρονθάριον.definition: Dim. of II, marginal gloss on Apollod.Poliorc.178.4 codd

γονυαλγής.definition: suffering pain in the knee, Hp.Epid.6.4.11

γνώστης.definition: one that knows, Act.Ap.26.3; = surety, Plu.Flam.4; expert witness or valuer, PLips.106.10

γέγωνα.definition: grido, mi faccio udire: pf. con valore di presente; anche presente derivato γεγωνέω

γεγωνέω.definition: gridare, farsi udire da lontano (= γέγωνα)
